FN-LVVXYA-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 57
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Representative Paul Lee
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 03/17/2023
House Bill 57 as introduced (1) proposes a pay grade increase for all circuit clerks effective in
January 2025, (2) provides for an annual one-step pay raise until the maximum step is reached
and (3) provides that any local pay supplement shall not be diminished. This bill would increase
the obligations of the Unified Judicial System, funded from the State Treasury, by an estimated
$806,000 in fiscal year 2025; a further estimated increase of $500,000 in fiscal year 2026; and
an increase of an additional 2.5% (one-step) each fiscal year thereafter.
